text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Finnish, Swedish and Estonian police suspect the presence of an amphetamine laboratory in Estonia.
- The city of Tallinn will use former bomb shelters to house the homeless in the coming winter.
- An Estonian firm has built a trench mortar and the defence ministry is considering the use of local industry for defence production.
- Estonian Foreign Minister Siim Kallas will meet his Russian counterpart Yevgeny Primakov in Petroskoi tomorrow to discuss border issues.
- Tallin Port plans to build a container terminal in Muuga, which could process 150,000 containers per year.
